messages.author: 3f22b207863d2049
messages.subject: Malaria paper published using Stan
parts:
Dear Stan Team,

For your records: we've just published a paper in PLoS Computational Biology on a non-linear model for malaria parasite kinetics in experimentally infected humans, using Stan to fit the model to data. Link and citation below.

This has been a pet project that's taken over five years. Many thanks to the Stan Team for their patience and help during the early stages of this work in trying to get the NUTS to not go nuts and behave! All the code and data are provided as supplements to the paper.

Best,

Luc

======================================================
http://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005255

}
